stories.title: 1 guest killed in Gorakhpur wedding:Clash between bride and groom’s sides over leg piece leaves another 'barati' critically injured
stories.summary: What began as a routine wedding celebration in Gorakhpur late Friday night turned into a bloody confrontation after a dispute over DJ songs and food spiralled out of control. One wedding guest was killed and another seriously injured after members from the bride’s and groom’s sides allegedly attacked each other with swords, belts, bricks and bamboo sticks. The incident took place at a marriage hall in Akolwa under Shahpur police station limits, where the daughter of Municipal Corporation employee Jitendra was getting married. Dispute escalates over songs and food According to eyewitnesses, tension first erupted after an argument over songs being played on the DJ system. The situation worsened further during dinner when a member of the wedding procession allegedly objected to not getting a chicken leg piece in the food. Within minutes, the verbal argument turned violent. People from both sides allegedly began pelting stones and bricks at each other inside the crowded marriage hall. Panic spread rapidly as guests, including women and children, ran for safety amid loud screams and chaos. What witnesses claimed Newly-married youth dies during treatment One of the injured, Sumit, a resident of Awas Vikas Colony in Shahpur, suffered critical injuries in the attack. He was rushed to hospital but died during treatment. Another injured youth, identified as Nepali, remains admitted in serious condition. The death has left Sumit’s family devastated. He had married barely three months ago and worked at a mobile phone shop on Jail Road to support his household. Family members said Silence and grief at Sumit’s house A pall of mourning descended on Sumit’s home on Saturday. His wife and mother were inconsolable as relatives gathered outside the house. Speaking to reporters, Sumit’s cousin Sandeep alleged that members of the bride’s side attacked him during the clash and beat him brutally after the dispute intensified around 10 pm. “He was targeted during the violence and could not survive the injuries,” he claimed. Accused absconding, police launch raids Soon after the violence, the accused allegedly fled from the marriage hall. Shahpur police reached the spot, took custody of the body and sent it for postmortem examination. Station House Officer Rajesh Roshan Singh said a case has been registered on the complaint of the victim’s family and raids are underway to arrest those involved. Police are also scanning CCTV footage and questioning eyewitnesses to identify the attackers. Wedding violence incidents raising concern The incident has once again highlighted the growing number of violent clashes at wedding functions over trivial disputes involving DJs, songs and food arrangements. Just a week ago, another stabbing incident was reported from a marriage hall in Bichhiya Tadikhana area under Shahpur police station limits after an argument over changing a song on the DJ console. Two people were seriously injured in that attack.

stories.title: Woman principal gets lawyer shot at in Prayagraj:Instigates two associates to open fire, 6 rounds fired from Thar
stories.summary: Priyadarshini Singh, principal of Bishop Johnson School (Junior Wing) in Katra, was arrested in the firing case involving former Allahabad University student leader and lawyer Rajneesh Kumar Singh. Police investigation revealed that Priyadarshini allegedly got her associates to fire six rounds at Rajneesh. Based on CCTV footage, police traced the accused and found that three people, including a woman, were inside the Mahindra Thar during the incident. Virendra Singh said the accused was produced in court on Friday and later granted bail. Raids are underway to arrest the other two accused. See 2 pictures Rajneesh returning home from village at the time of firing Rajneesh Kumar Singh lives near Shriya Apartment, Baba Chauraha. He is a former student leader and lawyer at Allahabad University. He stated that on the night of May 6, he was returning home from his village. Just then, a black Thar overtook their Fortuner on Stanley Road in Shivkuti, near the Cantonment area. Three people were in it. As soon as the Thar overtook and went ahead, the people inside started firing indiscriminately. FIR registered The miscreants fired six rounds one after another and then started fleeing. When chased, they turned left from Kalash intersection and, after going some distance, abandoned the Thar and fled. The vehicle had no number plate. Shivkuti police arrived upon information. However, no action was taken even after providing written information about the incident. The victim stated that the next day, he went with a complaint to Police Commissioner Jogendra Kumar and Additional Police Commissioner Dr. Ajaypal Sharma. Both officers reprimanded them, only then did Shivkuti police register a case at 1:16 PM on May 7. Lowered window and challenged, 'Kill them!' Victim Rajneesh Kumar Singh told the police that a woman was in the car. She lowered the window glass and said, 'Kill them!' Only after this did the Thar driver, sitting in the driving seat next to her, fire shots. Police sources say that in this case, at the time of the incident, Archie Timorthy was driving the Thar vehicle. He works in the office of Bishop Morris Edgar Dan of the Lucknow Diocese. Currently, he is being searched for.

stories.title: ‘No Muslim should eat our food’:Hindu Raksha Dal leader snatches man’s plate in Ghaziabad
stories.summary: Pinky Chaudhary, president of Hindu Raksha Dal, snatched a plate from the hand of a Muslim youth who had arrived at a 'bhandara' (community feast) in Ghaziabad. He can be heard saying, 'Listen, brother, no Mullah should come here. Whether anyone likes it or not.' After this, the youth leaves from there, while supporters are seen laughing after hearing their president's words. This video surfaced on Friday. According to Pinky Chaudhary, this is a video of an event held in Sahibabad and is about 20 days old. Know what is in the video A 43-second video of Pinky Chaudhary, president of Hindu Raksha Dal, surfaced on Friday. He is seen distributing food at a 'bhandara' (community meal). During the same time, a young man arrives there. Pinky Chaudhary asks him his name. The young man tells his name as Mulla. After hearing the name, he snatches the plate from his hands. He says, Remove him from here. No Mulla should come here. Whether anyone likes it or not, but no Mulla should come here. Meanwhile, after the plate was snatched from his hands, the young man left. While Pinky's supporters are seen smiling upon hearing his words. After the video surfaced, Pinky Chaudhary stated that the event was about 20 days old. I haven't said anything wrong. It is wrong for Muslims to attend Hindu events. I have done just that. However, it is not known who made the video. Had to go to jail for distributing swords to Hindus Pinky Chaudhary has been involved in controversies before. On December 29, 2025, a 21-second video of him surfaced. The video was from Ghaziabad's Shalimar Garden area. Pinky Chaudhary was seen distributing swords door-to-door with his supporters. In the video, supporters had swords and axes in their hands. Chanting 'Bharat Mata Ki Jai', they knocked on every house's door. When the homeowner came out, they handed him a sword, saying, 'This is for the protection of your sisters and daughters. If a situation like Bangladesh arises, it's for your protection from infidels.' In this case, on January 6, the police arrested Pinky Chaudhary and his son. After being released on bail on January 15, he took out a 25 km long procession.

stories.title: Akhilesh promises free education for girls if SP forms govt:Hits back at Rajbhar’s ‘Qawwal look’ jibe
stories.summary: Akhilesh Yadav on Saturday promised free education for girls from KG to PG, free treatment for the poor, and 300 units of free electricity if the Samajwadi Party forms the government in Uttar Pradesh. Speaking at Maharana Pratap’s birth anniversary event in Lucknow, he alleged UP ranks highest in crimes against women and accused the BJP government of reducing law and order to ‘zero.’ He also claimed many voters’ names were deleted in the 2024 elections and linked it to the ongoing SIR issue. Akhilesh also hit back at minister Om Prakash Rajbhar over remarks on superstition and his hairstyle, referring to Rajbhar’s old ‘Chal Sanyasi Mandir Mein…’ comment from the 2022 election campaign and saying, ‘At least I can comb my hair.’ Rajbhar had earlier posted on X that Akhilesh was resorting to superstition to win elections and had grown hair like ‘Qawwals.’ Key points from Akhilesh's press conference 1. Keeping an eye on West Bengal On the question of the ongoing political upheaval regarding government formation in Tamil Nadu, the SP chief said- I am not following the elections there. My focus is only on UP. Besides this, I am keeping an eye on everything that is happening in West Bengal. We are monitoring every update. 2. EC does not act on our complaint Regarding SIR, Akhilesh said that Nand Lal Nishad of Sultanpur did not know how to sign. His signature was taken. When I called him, I found out that he uses his thumbprint. BJP members were getting his name removed through Form 7 by taking his signature. We complained, but no action was taken. 3. ED must be coming to UP The SP chief said that ED must be coming to UP. Once it came to raid, it recovered 250 crores. It claimed that it was SP's money. Later, it turned out to be BJP's. If it was ours, then return the money. 4. We don't abandon each other in difficult times Regarding Rahul Gandhi's statement, 'Only Congress can confront BJP', he said that we don't abandon each other in difficult times. The alliance will remain strong. We will defeat the BJP by taking the public along. Actually, after the crushing defeat in Bengal-Tamil Nadu, Akhilesh had shared a photo with Mamata Banerjee and M.K. Stalin and said that we don't abandon each other in difficult times. After this, discussions began in political circles that SP would no longer support Congress. 5. The public will bring change The SP chief said that just as the BJP made gas cylinders expensive, now the prices of diesel and petrol are going to increase. They do not want to let profiteering decrease. Lucknow's Palacio Mall belonged to the government, they sold it. They sold Kisan Bazaar and a hotel. BJP promotes capitalism. They are working like a gang. The public defeating them will bring change. 6. Even 10 lakh forces will be less in UP Regarding the deployment of central forces in elections, he said, 3 lakh forces were deployed in Bengal. Even 10 lakh forces will be fewer in UP. Jawans from UP-Bihar were deployed in Bengal. In UP, they will bring from the Northeast. They will vacate the borders. This is the first time that jawans have been given 15 days' leave after the elections. 7. Appeal to workers - Do not go to any party's office The SP chief said on EVM - If smart meters can be controlled remotely, why can't EVMs be hacked? Regarding the protest of SP workers, he said that I would ask the workers not to go to any party's office. Unless there is an order from the party. We are not taking to the streets yet because BJP and the commission might manipulate the SIR. When the time comes, we will fight at every level. 8. A grand and magnificent statue of Maharana Pratap will be installed Akhilesh said - As soon as the SP government is formed, a grand and magnificent statue of Maharana Pratap will be installed on the country's most spectacular Gomti Riverfront. There will be a golden spear with Chetak. He demanded a two-day public holiday on Maharana Pratap Jayanti. This holiday will definitely be given during the SP government.

stories.title: IPL betting racket case:Constable’s live-in partner linked to racket in Jhansi; huge cash gold worth ₹2 cr recovered
stories.summary: Yashasvi Dwivedi (24), the girlfriend of absconding constable Rajat Singh, wanted to become a sub-inspector and had appeared for the SI recruitment exam last month. Police investigation revealed she is MA and B.Ed qualified and had also appeared for a teacher recruitment exam. Yashasvi and Rajat had been living in a rented flat in Royal City, a posh colony in Jhansi, in a live-in relationship for the past 12 months. Police raided the flat on Friday and arrested Yashasvi along with her associate, Nisha Khan (32). During the raid, police seized nine 100-gram gold biscuits, jewellery worth ₹1.55 crore, ₹19 lakh cash, 12 mobile phones, and laptops. The betting racket was allegedly led by BJP leader Ashish Upadhyay, who was arrested from Delhi seven days ago. Five accused, including the constable, are still absconding, and raids are underway to trace them. Full incident in sequence Informer tip-off leads to IPL betting raid in Jhansi SSP BB GTS Murthy said Sipri Bazar police were checking vehicles at Bihari Tiraha on Friday morning when an informer tipped them off about large-scale online IPL betting at flat LS9 in Royal City, Jhansi. Police immediately raided the flat. Police arrested Yashasvi Dwivedi (24), a resident of Chhaniyapura, and Nisha Khan (32), a resident of Shastri Nagar, Premnagar. A trolley bag found near the sofa contained huge amounts of cash and jewellery. Police recovered gold worth ₹1.46 crore, silver worth ₹11 lakh, cash, mobile phones, laptops, and other electronic equipment. Constable, BJP leader among accused During interrogation, police found that Yashasvi is the girlfriend of absconding constable Rajat Singh. Rajat allegedly ran the online IPL betting racket with associates Sumit Sahu, Ashish Upadhyay, Vishesh Bhargava, Prabhat Agrawal, and three unidentified persons. Police said the accused used the flat to place bets through mobile phones and laptops. The seized cash and jewellery were allegedly collected in exchange for running the betting network and had been brought to the flat by Rajat a few days earlier. The amount was to be distributed after the IPL league ended, and both women were also promised a share. Nisha Khan is reportedly the girlfriend of the accused Sumit. A case has been registered against all accused under the BNS and Gambling Act at Sipri Bazar police station. Yashasvi had left her family According to the police, Yashasvi had left her family at Rajat's behest. Both rented a flat in a posh colony like Royal City and started living in a live-in relationship. Later, she also got involved in the online betting business with Rajat. After her arrest, she told the police personnel that the one who couldn't get her the status of a wife eventually landed her in jail. Police are now investigating Yashasvi's bank accounts and financial transactions. It is suspected that money and assets related to the betting syndicate were channelled through her. Was preparing to flee Jhansi Sources say that there was a dispute between Nisha and Yashasvi over the distribution of money, after which the police got a clue, and the whole matter was revealed. Nishan told the police that Yashasvi was preparing to leave Jhansi with the cash. Constable had run over retired registrar Accused constable Rajat Kumar came into the limelight 12 days ago. Then, he had run over retired Assistant Registrar Maniram Verma (70) with a THAR vehicle at Bundelkhand University. Maniram died on the spot. He was then arrested and sent to jail. The SSP had suspended him and initiated departmental action. He had been released from jail a few days ago. He had reported for duty (in the police line) only on Thursday. After this, his name came up in betting. The SSP dismissed constable Rajat on Friday. Before being suspended, Rajat was posted at Poonch police station. He has also been in SOG for many years. These people have been accused in the betting case

stories.title: Mixed weather pattern witnessed in UP:Storm rain forecasted for 17 districts; severe heatwave to push temperature above 45°C in coming days
stories.summary: The spell of storms and rain continues across Uttar Pradesh. On Saturday (May 9), a rain alert has been issued for 17 districts in Purvanchal, with winds expected to reach speeds of up to 50 kmph during this period. In contrast, weather conditions remained clear since morning across western UP and several other regions, with bright sunshine observed during the day. However, cool breezes in many areas have helped provide relief from the prevailing heat. Western disturbance weakens, temperatures set to rise again The Meteorological Department has stated that the ongoing western disturbance is gradually weakening and is expected to end completely by today. After its withdrawal, temperatures are likely to rise steadily over the next three days, with a possible increase of 5–6°C. In some areas, the mercury may once again cross the 45°C mark, leading to intense heat conditions. However, officials have indicated that relief from heatwave conditions is likely to continue for the time being. Rain, hail and strong winds disrupt life in parts of UP In the past 24 hours, several districts of Uttar Pradesh, including Agra, Jalaun, Lalitpur and Mau, witnessed rain accompanied by strong winds. Hailstorm activity was also reported in Mau, while wedding preparations in Lalitpur were disrupted due to sudden weather changes. Meanwhile, most other cities such as Lucknow, Kanpur, Noida and Ghaziabad experienced clear weather conditions. Varanasi recorded the highest temperature in the state at 39°C, making it the hottest location during the period. 4 flights cancelled in Lucknow Bad weather conditions in Bihar, Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh has also affected air operations in Lucknow, leading to the cancellation of four flights to and from the city. An IndiGo flight from Kolkata was diverted to Lucknow after it was unable to land at Patna airport due to poor visibility and adverse weather conditions. The aircraft reportedly circled in the air for some time before being safely diverted. ‘Ongoing spell of rain likely to pause’ Senior scientist Atul Kumar Singh at the Regional Meteorological Centre said, “The ongoing spell of rain in the state since April 30 is now likely to pause, which may lead to a rise in temperatures and a gradual intensification of summer conditions. However, relief from heatwave situations will continue for now”. He further noted that continuous rainfall had already brought down maximum temperatures by around 9°C. While Banda had recorded a peak of 47.6°C on April 28, it dropped to around 39°C by May 8. He also indicated that a fresh weather system is expected to become active after two days, which may trigger another spell of rain. Know the condition of cities See the pictures- Why fluctuations in weather? The weather department reports continuous changes in the hilly regions of Uttarakhand, with snowfall in some areas, rainfall in others, and intermittent clear spells with sunshine. These fluctuations are expected to continue for the next 2–3 days. Their impact is also being felt in Uttar Pradesh, where winds from the mountains are keeping temperatures moderate and supporting conditions favourable for rain. stories.title: Father kills his only 13-year-old son:Body dumped in pond in Noida; Accused stabs himself in neck after being caught
stories.summary: A father strangled his 13-year-old only son to death in Greater Noida. He threw the body in a pond by the roadside, away from home. He came home and fabricated a false story that his son had gone missing. Police started the investigation, and when the family checked nearby CCTV footage, the son was last seen with his father. Despite this, he continued to mislead the police. After some time, information was received that the child's body had been found in the pond. When the police became strict, the father confessed to the murder. During this time, he also attempted suicide by cutting his own throat with a knife. People stopped him by snatching the knife away. Currently, his treatment is ongoing in the hospital. The accused told police during interrogation that he committed the crime to frame his brothers in a property dispute. The incident occurred on Wednesday in Sirsa village under the Kasna police station area. 2 Pictures- Now understand the entire case in a sequential manner- Father went out in car with Sudhanshu, returned alone According to police, the accused Pradeep alias Pappi lives with his family in the 6 Percent Colony of Sirsa village in Kasna. His only son, 13-year-old Sudhanshu, was studying in 8th grade. On Wednesday, Pradeep went out in his car with Sudhansh. He returned alone. When family members asked, he said that Sudhansh had gone somewhere. When Sudhansh didn't return by night, the family became worried. Pradeep then kept telling different stories to the family. Uncle filed a complaint with police about nephew's disappearance Meanwhile, Pradeep's brother filed a complaint with the police about his nephew going missing. When police examined CCTV footage from the house and the surrounding areas, Sudhansh was last seen going with his father. During police interrogation, Pradeep kept changing his statement repeatedly. Sometimes he would say he had dropped his son off at a friend's house, and other times he would say he was at a relative's house. He claimed that he had left his son with an acquaintance in Gulistanpur village, but this too turned out to be false upon investigation. People around saw the body in the pond Meanwhile, some people from the neighborhood saw a body floating in a nearby pond. When the matter reached the police, the body was taken out. Upon strict interrogation, Pradeep revealed that he first murdered his son by strangulation. Then he threw the body in the pond, so that the case would appear to be one of kidnapping or murder. He wanted to take revenge on his brothers for a land dispute. To frame them, he murdered his son. Pradeep's family includes his elder brother Sandeep, younger brothers Mohit and Rohit. Pradeep has a daughter, Nidhika, and Sudhanshu was the younger one. They all live in the same house. Dispute over 2 bigha land on roadside According to the family, the land has been divided among the four brothers. 2 bigha of land is on the roadside. The shops built on it fetch good rent. While the shops built at the back fetch less rent. The dispute is over that land. Pradeep wanted to take the land on the roadside. Pradeep had a suspicion that all the brothers would grab that land. He would get nothing. Pradeep didn't do anything either. He was addicted to drugs. He used to drink alcohol and smoke ganja. His expenses were met from the rent of the shops. He had also received some compensation for the land. He had built a house with that money. He had bought a car. Villagers said that Pradeep used to complain about his brothers to the tehsil and officers every day. Killed his son to frame his brothers According to police officials, the accused Pradeep had an ongoing dispute with some members of his family over property. In this dispute, he hatched a horrific conspiracy and killed his own son.

stories.title: UP gang offers fake rape case in ₹20 lakh:Kingpin says 16-yr-old will get physical with someone else and another will be framed
stories.summary: 'Look, she's a 16-17 year old girl. First we'll get her physically examined by someone else. After that, whoever you name, we'll trap them. They'll go straight to jail, won't even get bail. This will cost ₹20 lakhs. If we trap someone in a rape case with an adult girl, it will be ₹2-3 lakhs less.' This is what the female gang leader says, who is running a fake FIR gang in UP. There are dozens of girls in the gang. Many of them are even educated. These girls trap anyone in rape charges at the gang leader's signal. They have a network in all 75 districts of UP. Many lives have been ruined by fake rape cases in the country. A few days ago, young engineer Abhishek Srivastava from Gonda was trapped in a false rape case by his married girlfriend who extorted lakhs of rupees. After spending 10 days in jail, he committed suicide and left evidence of his innocence stuck on the walls. Regarding fake rape cases, the High Court had said - "False accusations of rape cause mental agony, humiliation and damage to reputation, it is necessary to control this." Police caught a fake rape case racket in Prayagraj a few months ago. In this, women and lawyers would trap people in rape cases and extort money from them. Dainik Bhaskar team searched the network for 3 months to reach such a gang operating in UP. We came in contact with the gang members. We exposed the female gang leader, young women who trap people in rape cases, and girls under 18 years of age who file POCSO cases. Read the complete investigation Female ringleader has more than 20 girls Who is running the gang that traps people in false rape cases? To answer this question, we studied rape and POCSO cases in UP over the past year. We found a source who knew a young woman from the gang that files fake FIRs. We met her posing as a common man and talked about spending money to trap someone in a fake rape case. The source called the young woman and told her about us. After 15 days of continuous follow-up, a young woman met us. She told us that this gang has been operating for 10-12 years. A woman named Safalta Pathak is running the gang while living in Lucknow. She is originally from Jhansi. The gang has 20-22 young women. Some are minors as well. Expert in filing fake rape cases and securing evidence When the gang realized that we were a big party and could easily spend 20-25 lakh rupees, the gang leader Safalata Pathak agreed to meet us out of greed for money. The meeting took place at a cafe in Lucknow. Safalata explained to us the methods from filing fake cases, trapping someone in them, to proving them right... Safalata Pathak: Tell me briefly what the problem is? Reporter: Okay, I'll tell you the whole thing in short. (We told her that two people from the same family, who are 30 years old, need to be framed in a rape case. Our priority in this is POCSO.) Safalata Pathak: Okay, we will send them inside (jail), first give me their complete details. Reporter: How many days will the work take? Safalata Pathak: When you give complete information, then we will find out about it. What does your client do, the one who needs to be framed? You are trusting me, I am trusting you. Gang even gets rape report prepared by doctor When we raised questions about the minor girl and weak evidence of rape, ringleader Safalata Pathak said without hesitation - we will arrange the girl, we will also get the rape report prepared by the doctor. According to the ringleader, the most important links in any such case are - the girl's statement, medical report and police action. She assured that all three aspects are under control. Trapping someone in rape is normal for us, we have settings in all police stations - Ringleader Reporter: Do you have minor girls? Safalata Pathak: That, you leave it to us. First give the details, rest I can find out everything sitting here. The work will be done, I am fully confident. Reporter: How long will the work take? Safalata Pathak: I will tell you after the details and meeting with the client. Reporter: Roughly how much will it cost? Safalata Pathak: I will tell you. 376 (rape case) is normal for us. Whether something happened or not, we will get it filed. Reporter: Do you have a setting with the police? Safalata Pathak: I will get an FIR filed in any police station. Gang has several minor girls, ringleader brought them along for show The female ringleader Safalata Pathak came with a girl who sat beside her during the deal. The girl appeared to be 15-16 years old. Safalata said - this is a minor, we will make her file the allegations. After this, Safalata told us about the money transactions and evidence to strengthen the case. Ringleader Safalata gave 3 options - POCSO, rape and narcotics Safalata Pathak: Please confirm with your client, POCSO is not a light matter, there will be no bail. We will have to talk to the minor girl and her family. I can go to any level. Reporter: The client has mentioned 8-10 lakhs for this work. Safalata Pathak: Okay, is 10 lakhs final? Reporter: Where is the minor girl from? Safalata Pathak: There are many girls, you leave it to us. Reporter: And what about the doctor's report? Safalata Pathak: The report will also be made, we have contacts in Barabanki hospital. Money works everywhere, we will get it done. Reporter: You will have to manage everything for 10 lakh rupees. Payment will be made in 3 installments. Safalata Pathak: Usually it's 50% advance, but okay. Reporter: The client's name should not come up. Safalata Pathak: It won't come up anywhere. The minor girl will give a statement and then you won't know anything. We'll make all fake documents. I have learned law without studying law. There is no place where I don't have a setting. Reporter: Okay. Safalata Pathak: You have 3 options - first POCSO, second - 376 meaning rape of a young woman, and third - Narcotics. Trapping in Narcotics is the easiest. Reporter: How? Safalata Pathak: Whoever's details you provide, drugs will be planted in their vehicle. After going some distance, they will be caught. In this too, bail is difficult. The first meeting with ringleader Safalata Pathak ended with the understanding that we would arrange his meeting with the client. Now we wanted to know what the rate is for trapping someone in a false FIR? For this, we prepared for a second sting. Now we involved a fellow reporter. He was presented as a client. To show him as wealthy, the second meeting was arranged at a 4-star hotel located in Gomti Nagar. 3 hours after the call, the ringleader Safalata Pathak arrived at the hotel with her female associate. Now the final discussion took place... Will easily trap in narcotics, won't be able to get out of jail for 4-6 years - Ringleader Safalata Pathak: We want to tell you one thing. It was very important for you to come before us. When you trust us and we trust you, only then will the work move forward. Now tell us your issue openly, what is the problem? Reporter: There is a person living in our neighborhood, who needs to be trapped. Safalata Pathak: Give us his details. If your work doesn't get done, then except for the money spent, the remaining amount will be returned. Reporter: Money is not a problem. Safalta Pathak: You gave us two options, but we told you about one more option. You also know that bail is granted in POCSO Act as well. Apart from this, there is also the option of Narcotics and 376 (Rape). Reporter: Our first priority is POCSO. Safalta Pathak: In POCSO, the girl's age should be less than 18 years. Where does the person to be framed live, when does he come out, complete information is necessary. Reporter: We will give you all that. Safalata Pathak: You know - the girl's statement, doctor's report and police station are most important, we will manage all that. The boy will go to jail. You give us complete details of the police station and the boy. Reporter: Sir (fellow reporter) just wanted to know where and how much will be spent? Safalata Pathak: Look, in this line payment is made together. Come on, you give 50% advance, rest after the work is done. We need one day's time. I will talk to the minor girl and her family about what their demand is. Reporter: Will the money spent be less in 376 (rape) case? Safalata Pathak: Look, the girl will be taken somewhere else for a physical examination, then somewhere else she'll be made to endure beating, only then will the case become strong. For this, we need a strong girl who can tolerate 2-4 slaps, because even at the police station everyone knows that if the matter is set up, then their demands are different. Reporter: What will be the rate for 376 (rape)? Safalata Pathak: Your objective is - to send to jail, the option I've given you - narcotics, in that he won't be able to come out for 4 to 6 years. If you don't want to drag it too long, then this option is fine. Narcotics won't take much time. You told me today, day after tomorrow we'll send him to jail, work done. In this, only the police station needs to be managed, the narcotics department people are managed. Reporter: How will you trap him? Safalata Pathak: The girl will suddenly come in front of his car, he will get down from the car to check and here, in the crowd, they will plant drugs in his car. Then the narcotics people standing ahead will catch him. This is a shortcut method. There are many types of drugs. Like - marijuana, hashish, opium and much more. Reporter: How much money will it cost? Safalata Pathak: In POCSO it will go above 20 lakhs. Narcotics will also cost around this much, because drugs alone will cost 4-5 lakhs. In 376 (rape), give 2 or 3 lakhs less. Even after being slapped, the educated young women of the gang don't tell the truth Just then, ringleader Safalata Pathak calls a young woman. She sits in front of us. Young, fair-colored and boldness on her face. Neither any hesitation nor any shame. Age 25-26 years. She introduced herself as Manpreet Kaur, said- I am a resident of Chandigarh. The young woman was answering every question in fluent English. I will do whatever didi says, will even undergo physical examination- Manpreet Kaur Reporter: Are you comfortable with filing Section 376 (rape)? Manpreet Kaur: Yes, sir. Whatever didi (Safalata Pathak) says, I will do that. Reporter: You won't back out? Manpreet Kaur: No. Reporter: For rape, will you have sex with someone else? Manpreet Kaur: Don't say sex, I'll get physical. Can't hide anywhere in UP's 75 districts, will hunt you down and kill you How dangerous is gang leader Safalta Pathak? Her claim is that she has connections with police officers in police stations across all 75 districts of UP. Many shooters work for her. During the sting operation, she threatened the Bhaskar reporter. She said - If you betray us, you won't be able to hide anywhere in UP's 75 districts. We'll hunt you down and kill you. Many shooters are in my contact. More than 300 fake rape cases in UP alone in one year According to the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) 2025 report, 40,393 rape cases were registered in the country in 2023. stories.title: 'Leave your parents if you want to live with me’:Husband in Gonda says wife demanded ₹10 lakh despite family selling buffaloes to fund her studies
stories.summary: In Gonda, a 5th pass youth worked as a laborer to get his wife to complete a nursing (ANM) course. He says that after getting a job, his wife is not ready to live with him. She is demanding 10 lakh rupees. She says that if you want to live with me, then leave your elderly parents. The husband said that his wife insisted on studying while staying at her maternal home. I worked day and night as a laborer. I even sold a buffalo to pay for her education expenses. Now my wife wants to get rid of me. The victim has filed a complaint with the police demanding the return of money spent on education and jewelry. The case is from Chapratalla Kaurhe village in Motiganj police station area. Now read the complete case Rajesh Kumar Verma, a resident of Chapartalla Kaurhe village, was married in 2001 to Renu Verma, daughter of Ram Ujagar. She is a resident of Pipra Lalach village. Rajesh said that at the time of marriage, his age was 8 to 10 years. The gauna (consummation ceremony) took place 17 years later in 2018, after which Renu lived with him for some time. During this period, Renu expressed her desire to pursue an ANM course. In 2022, she went to her maternal home. She sold the anklets worth 12 thousand rupees that I had given her and got admission. Later, I also started supporting my wife's education. Due to weak financial condition, I worked in Punjab and did iron loading work. Rajesh says- Renu is demanding 10 lakhs to live together Rajesh alleges that after getting a job in a hospital in Gonda, his wife Renu is now not ready to live with him. His wife and in-laws are pressuring him to leave his parents and live separately in Gonda. If he doesn't do so, they ask him to settle by paying 10 lakh rupees. Rajesh said that his father is mentally ill. His mother has lost her eyesight. In such a situation, he cannot live separately with his wife even if he wants to, leaving his parents behind. Husband is 5th pass, sold 2 buffaloes for wife's education Rajesh said that he sent lakhs of rupees online for his wife's education. Apart from this, he sold two buffaloes and gave 20 thousand and 15 thousand rupees. He also spent 60 thousand rupees received from selling sugarcane on his wife's education. During her studies, his wife had promised that she would stay at her maternal home until she got a job. After getting a job, she would start living together. But now she is not ready to come home. His wife and in-laws have also kept the jewelry given during the wedding and gauna ceremony. He went to his in-laws' place several times to bring his wife, but was turned away each time. Now he has demanded justice from the administration. I have only studied till fifth grade. I worked as a laborer and educated my wife, but now she is saying that she won't come to your house. Wife said- Arranged money for studies myself Meanwhile, Renu Verma denied the allegations made by her husband and in-laws. She said that whenever she went to her in-laws' house, her husband and father-in-law would beat her. That's why she couldn't stay there for more than three-four days. Her husband and in-laws did not help her with even one rupee for her studies. Due to financial constraints, she couldn't even fill her exam form at one time. Later, she somehow arranged money, completed her studies and gave the exam. Regarding the question of asking for money, she said that she has spent money on her studies and getting a job, so she will definitely ask for an account of it. Working in Gonda, want husband to live with me here According to Renu Verma, she had told her husband that she is working in Gonda, so her husband should stay with her there. When she gets the opportunity, she will go to her in-laws' place. But her husband and in-laws are pressuring her to stay in the village. Renu alleged that her husband came to her rented room in Gonda and assaulted her. Several complaints have been filed against him, from the SP office to the women's police station. Now attempts are being made to defame her. Women's Police Station In-charge Anita Yadav said- The case is ongoing at our Family Counseling Center. These people came once, the husband is telling his wife to leave her job and stay at our home. The wife is not ready to leave her job. Both have been called again on Sunday. Renu had said that I will go home. I will not leave him, but I will also not leave my job and stay at home.

stories.title: UP weather machines show faulty flood alerts:₹137 crore paid to company despite official warnings on system faults
stories.summary: In UP, when there is light rain, the meteorological department's machines are showing flood-like conditions. If clouds appear, they are sending messages of sunshine. This malfunction is due to the Automatic Weather Stations and Automatic Rain Gauges installed 2 years ago. A Hyderabad company had installed these machines in all tehsils and blocks. After receiving initial data from these machines, the Meteorological Department wrote a letter to the Relief Commissioner- The equipment is not providing accurate data. Temperatures below 44C are being shown as over 50C. Light rain is being reported as heavy rain. Please consider before making payment. Despite this, the Relief Department paid Rs 137 crore to the Hyderabad contractor company. The result is that the Meteorological Department is unable to get accurate information about storms and rain. Know where the matter started from Stations were built for weather forecasting, machines were installed In 2023, the Relief Department decided to install Automatic Weather Stations and Automatic Rain Gauges in 826 blocks and 351 tehsils of UP for accurate weather forecasting. The project was approved in the State Executive Committee meeting. A fund of 141.6 crore rupees was received to install 450 weather stations and 2000 automatic rain gauges in UP. After the tender process, the department awarded the contract to Hyderabad-based company Obel Systems Private Limited for 137 crores to install both machines. The company installed the equipment at tehsils and blocks in UP. The Meteorological Department did the verification The contract stipulated that the verification of the operation of these devices would be done by the Meteorological Department. Verification had to be done on 3 points- After verification, the Meteorological Department had to submit a report. Only after finding everything correct in this, the Relief Department had to make payment to the company installing the machines. Discrepancies found in verification On June 21, 2025, Director of Meteorological Department Dr. Manish R. Ranalkar wrote a letter to the then Relief Commissioner Bhanuchandra Goswami. He informed that the machines are not giving correct data (readings). The data received from weather stations is saved on IMD's Pune server. This data is also stored on the UP government's web portal. Due to incorrect data, IMD (Lucknow) is unable to make accurate weather predictions. The director further wrote - When we verify and compare this data, discrepancies are coming to light. When will the heat increase? When will the weather remain normal? Will it rain or not? Difficulties are arising even in estimating such basic information. Suggestion given - The quality of these machines' network should be checked. Also, attention needs to be paid to maintenance. Temperature and rainfall predictions proved wrong 1. Reality 44C, machine showing over 50C The machines installed at the weather station are giving incorrect feeds regarding temperature. When the temperature at the meteorological department's own centers doesn't even reach 44C, these new machines were recording temperatures above 50C. That is, there wasn't as much heat on the ground as these machines were showing. 2. When not a drop fell from the sky, machines recorded 'heavy rainfall' The condition of the station machines is such that even in scorching heat, they were giving data of 'torrential rain'. The limit was crossed when these machines recorded several times more rainfall compared to the actual IMD (India Meteorological Department) centers. That is, where light drizzles occurred, these machines gave data indicating 'flood'-like conditions. This was making it difficult for the department to provide accurate weather forecasts. According to the Director of the Meteorological Department, behind this major system failure were these negligences by the department and the company- Company's Major Negligence: Neither Conducted Inspection, Nor Corrected Data The Director of the Meteorological Department raised questions about the work of the Hyderabad-based company 'Obel Systems' in his letter. The department had asked the company to implement a data verification system on the server, so that bad or incorrect data could be filtered out and accurate information could be obtained. However, the company did not create any such system. The department had given strict instructions that the company should get its sensors re-examined by IMD Pune or any government-recognized (NABL) lab. The company did not get the sensors examined even once. The company was supposed to carry out maintenance of stations and inspection of machines from time to time. The report says that the company neither did maintenance nor tested the machines. The director wrote that Obell System Pvt. Ltd. did not comply with the tender conditions. Payment to the firm should be considered only after verification. Delhi lawyer's claim - Meeting with company at Jhansi hotel Delhi advocate Abhishek Saxena filed a complaint with the CBI. He alleged that the then Relief Commissioner Bhanuchandra Goswami and his OSD Manoj Kumar met with MD of Obell System Pvt. Ltd., O. Reddy, at a hotel in Jhansi on October 3, 2024. The deal was finalized in this meeting. What is Obell Systems Private Limited? Obell Systems Private Limited company was started in 1999 with the name Obell Computers Private Limited. In 2012, the company's name was changed to Obell Projects Private Limited. In 2016, the company's name was changed to Obell Systems Private Limited. The company has so far installed 2978 Automatic Weather Stations, 6429 Automatic Rain Gauges, and 137 Automatic Water Level Recorders in different states. Now the officials' statement We reported the defects in the machines In this entire matter, Director of Meteorology Department Dr. Manish R. Ranalkar says, 'We had submitted our report to the Relief Commissioner's office. In this, the defects that were there in the Automatic Weather Stations and Automatic Rain Gauges were mentioned. We had stated that payment should be made only after verification as per tender conditions. After that, no report was taken from us.'

stories.title: Agra wedding turns chaotic:Groom throws garland, flees as woman claims he is her husband; high-voltage drama lasted for 2 hours
stories.summary: During the Jaimala ceremony in Agra, the groom threw away the garland and ran off the stage after seeing a woman who suddenly arrived at the wedding procession of four cars, claiming, ‘The groom is my husband.’ When she created a scene, the groom’s elder brother stepped forward. The drama took a new turn when the elder brother claimed the woman was actually his wife and the groom’s sister-in-law. He alleged she had been in a relationship with his younger brother for several years and wanted to leave him to marry the groom. The high-voltage drama continued for nearly two hours, prompting most guests to flee. Meanwhile, the bride’s family was left stunned, and the bride remained seated in her wedding dress till late at night. Eventually, her family married her to another young man present there. The incident took place on Friday night in Etmadpur, about 20 km from the city. Police have taken the groom’s father and brother into custody. The wedding procession had arrived from Tundla. See 3 pictures Read the full story in detail A wedding procession from Firozabad arrived at a marriage hall in Etmadpur on Friday night. Jitendra Baghel, a resident of Mangalam City, Tundla, had arrived with his wedding procession. The wedding rituals were underway. After the Lagni and Pakki rituals, preparations for the varmala (garland exchange) were ongoing. The bride and groom had reached the stage. Both had varmalas in their hands. Before the bride and groom could exchange garlands, a woman arrived with some people in 4 cars. As soon as the woman moved towards the stage, the groom's eyes fell on her. He threw the varmala and ran off the stage. Meanwhile, the woman reached near the stage. Creating a commotion, she said, ‘He is my husband.’ As soon as the woman shouted this, the wedding guests and the bride's family were stunned. The DJ was stopped, and the dancing feet of the performers came to a halt. In no time, an argument broke out between the people who came with the woman and some of the wedding guests. The woman kept insisting that the groom, Jitendra, was her husband. Meanwhile, the family informed the police. The police arrived. They took the groom's brother and father into custody and brought them to the police station. Groom's brother said, ‘The woman is my wife’ After reaching the police station, a second twist came in the story. In front of the police, the groom's brother, Nem Singh, claimed that the woman was his wife. Both were married in 2018. But the brother-in-law and sister-in-law have been having an affair for several years. The brother claimed that his wife accuses him of being impotent and wants to marry his brother. Bride marries another man at venue During this dispute of the groom's family, silence fell over the wedding ceremony. Some people from the groom's and bride's side had a conversation. It was decided that this marriage would not take place. After this, the bride was married to another young man present at the same ceremony. He was known to the bride's side. This wedding ritual took place simply at a different location within the same premises. Etmadpur Station In-charge Alok Kumar Singh said, Police arrived on the information of a woman. The woman accused the groom of a second marriage. The groom had fled from the spot. The groom's father and brother have been taken into custody. The matter is being investigated. The bride's side has not filed any complaint.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:BJP leader, businessman arrested over double murder in Baghpat; WB sees 86.90% voter turnout till 5 pm in re-polling more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest updates from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines in present tense: 1. 86.90% voter turnout till 5 pm in Bengal re-polling In West Bengal, re-polling took place on Saturday at 15 booths. By 5 pm, Magrahat West recorded 86.11% voter turnout, while Diamond Harbour registered 87.60%. 2. BJP leader, businessman arrested over double murder in Baghpat Two murders within 15 days in Baghpat have shocked locals, with both bodies later recovered in Saharanpur. The victims were contractual employee Vikrant and his girlfriend Rakhi. Rakhi, known for carrying a pistol, had been divorced twice and was in a relationship with 42-year-old married Vikrant. The back-to-back killings left people wondering what led to the double murder. 3. 80,000 police 50,000 in education dept posts to be filled up in UP this year The Uttar Pradesh government has set a target of providing jobs to 1.5 lakh youths this year. Around 80,000 recruitments are likely in the Police Department, while nearly 50,000 vacancies may be filled in the Education Department. Apart from this, recruitments have also been proposed in the Revenue, Medical, Judicial, Women and Child Development departments. The government aims to achieve its larger goal of providing 10 lakh jobs in 10 years. 4. Govt tests nationwide emergency alert system At 11.45 am on Saturday, an emergency alert appeared on the screens of phones with the sound of beeps. This alert was out after the beep stopped. Many people were upset by this, and many were confused. 5. UP Cong chief Ajay Rai in ICU, PM Modi Rahul Gandhi wish speedy recovery UP Congress chief Ajay Rai’s health suddenly deteriorated on Friday afternoon. He became unconscious and was immediately admitted to Medanta Hospital. In the emergency ward, he was treated under the supervision of specialist doctors and later shifted to the ICU. His condition is now said to be out of danger. 6. Kanpur doctors implant world's smallest pacemaker in 77-year-old man Doctors at the Heart Institute (Cardiology) have achieved a major breakthrough in medical treatment by giving a 77-year-old man a new lease of life with the world’s smallest wireless pacemaker, implanted without major surgery or any incision. 7. Over 120 nations hike petrol, diesel prices since Iran war As global energy markets face their most volatile period in decades, a unique economic miracle is playing out at Indian petrol pumps - and this has won citizens' heart. 8. Fed up with faulty smart meters, UP women uproot dump it at power offices In Agra, Firozabad and several other cities, hundreds of women uprooted smart meters installed at their homes, carried them on their heads to electricity department offices and threw them there in protest. 9. Akhilesh ‘two stools’ jibe over Deputy CMs’ reel stirs controversy Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav on Friday night shared a reel of both Deputy Chief Ministers Keshav Prasad Maurya and Brajesh Pathak on ‘X’. The background music in the video was, “Duniya ke thagon se bachne zara…” Along with it, he took a dig in the caption, writing, “Do stools ko milane se kursi nahi banti.” 10. Silver price decreased by ₹3,389 to ₹2.40 lakh per kg, gold became cheaper by ₹1,216 This week saw a decline in gold and silver prices. Gold fell by ₹1,216 during the week to ₹1,50,263 per 10 grams. Earlier, it was at ₹1,51,479 on April 25 last week.

stories.title: High-tension current spreads in Bareilly homes, claims 2 lives:Residents allege officials ignored repeated complaint of damaged transformer
stories.summary: Due to alleged gross negligence by the electricity department in Bareilly, two families in the same village lost their loved ones after current from a high-tension line entered the household supply and spread through the area. In the accident at Sudanpur village, an 11th-class student and a differently-abled young man died on the spot. While trying to save the student, his mother suffered severe burns and was admitted to hospital in critical condition. Villagers alleged they had repeatedly complained about damaged transformers and power lines and submitted applications, but officials ignored them, leading to the two deaths. Boy dies after touching electrified iron gate Subhash (16), son of Udal Singh, a resident of Sudhanpur village, was about to leave for school today morning around 7:30 am after getting ready. As soon as he touched the iron gate to step out of the house, the high-tension current running through it electrocuted him. Subhash died a painful death on the spot with a loud bang. His mother Sunita (45), who rushed to save her son, also got severely burnt after being electrocuted. She has been admitted to a private hospital in the city, where her condition remains critical. Differently-abled youth also dies In the same accident, Kunwar Pal (24) from the same village also died. Kunwar Pal was differently-abled in one leg and used to help his family by doing tailoring work at home. The sudden high voltage in the house lights did not even give him a chance to react. Kunwar Pal was the third among four brothers, and his family plunged into mourning after this incident. Villagers say that the negligence of the electricity department has turned a lively village into a cremation ground. 11,000 volt current in house's 440 volt line RP Singh, the cousin of the deceased Subhash, was present at the scene of the incident. He witnessed his brother's agonizing death right before his eyes. He said, This entire accident in our village happened due to electricity negligence. My cousin and aunt, along with the son of our other brother Vedram, were electrocuted. This all happened because an 11,000-volt high-tension line current entered the house's 440-volt line. Regarding the malfunction of this transformer, we had repeatedly informed the electricity department and public representatives, such as our MLA, in writing. Any members of the department who visited the village were repeatedly told that this transformer is faulty. Sometimes the electricity comes with such high intensity that the cables on the poles catch fire. Yesterday too, fire was burning on every pole in the entire locality.When my cousin was about to leave home in the morning, there was such a strong electric current in the gate that there was no way to save him. The current had spread throughout the entire gate. After much effort, when we broke the electricity meter with sticks and cut the wires, only then did the fire extinguish and they could be rescued. The atmosphere there was like an explosion. We complained repeatedly, my sister-in-law also gave it in writing, but the electricity department has not paid any attention to it till date. In this accident, one of my nephews and my cousin have passed away, and my aunt is admitted to the hospital in serious condition. Responsible officers did not wake up even after written complaint Pankaj Kumar, who was present at the spot, has made serious allegations against the administration. He said that the village transformer often had problems, and the electricity sometimes came very low and sometimes so high that the cables caught fire. A written complaint about this was made to the electricity department officials as well as the local MLA. But no one solved the problem. Villagers have now demanded strict action against the guilty officials and compensation for the victims.

stories.title: Mayawati calls for control on petroleum prices:People already troubled by inflation; fuel hike sparks concern
stories.summary: BSP chief Mayawati has warned the government about the simultaneous increase of Rs 993 in the price of commercial gas cylinders. She said that this increase has spread unrest among common people. Mayawati said that the prices of cooking gas, petrol, diesel, and other petroleum products may also increase soon. She appealed to the government to follow the same policy now, just as petroleum prices were kept under control during the elections. BSP chief Mayawati said, Whether it's the US-Israel war on Iran or any other reason, such a sudden large increase in prices is troubling the common public. The government should keep prices under control in public interest. She informed that in Delhi, the price of a commercial cylinder at the new rate will now exceed approximately three thousand rupees. Mayawati said that this increase will badly affect the poor and middle-class people who are already struggling with inflation. Therefore, the government should formulate policies only after reassessing its decision.

stories.title: Assam Rifles jawan’s celebratory firing kills child in Ballia:Bullet passes through 8-yr-old boy’s chest, police register case
stories.summary: An eight-year-old boy was killed after being hit during celebratory firing at a wedding in Ballia, Uttar Pradesh. The boy died on the spot after the bullet passed through his chest. Sunil Yadav, the accused, who's an Assam Rifles jawan, fled the scene after the incident in Shivpur Diar on Friday night. Meanwhile, police have registered an FIR in the case. First see 2 pictures... The case in detail On Friday, a wedding ceremony of two daughters of Prem Yadav was being held in Purwa Pandey ka Dera village. Both wedding processions had arrived from Bihar. Around 10:15 pm, during the welcome of the baraat and dance celebrations, some people began celebratory firing. During the firing, Prem Yadav’s brother-in-law Sunil Yadav also joined in and fired his double-barrel gun. During the firing, his weapon reportedly became unbalanced and a bullet struck 8-year-old Veer Yadav, son of Sanjay Yadav, who was standing nearby in the baraat. The bullet passed through the child’s chest. He collapsed on the spot and died. After the incident, panic spread in the wedding gathering. The family was thrown into chaos. He was rushed to a hospital, where doctors declared him dead. Upon receiving information, police reached the spot and sent the body for post-mortem. Based on a complaint by the family, an FIR has been registered against the accused jawan. Meanwhile, the joy of the wedding turned into mourning, and after completing formal rituals, the ceremonies were concluded and the baraat was sent back. Police team formed to arrest the accused Additional Superintendent of Police (South) Sanjay Verma said- A child has died due to celebratory firing. The person who fired the shot is a relative. An FIR has been registered based on the family’s complaint, and a police team has been formed to arrest the accused.

stories.title: UP Congress chief Ajay Rai in ICU after chest pain:PM Modi, Rahul Gandhi wish speedy recovery; his condition is now stable
stories.summary: UP Congress chief Ajay Rai’s health suddenly deteriorated on Friday afternoon. He became unconscious and was immediately admitted to Medanta Hospital. In the emergency ward, he was treated under the supervision of specialist doctors and later shifted to the ICU. His condition is now said to be out of danger. Ajay Rai complained of chest pain and fainted inside his car while returning home. Prime Minister Narendra Modi posted on ‘X’ at 11:54 pm on Friday, wishing him a speedy recovery. He wrote that he was saddened to hear about Ajay Rai’s illness and prayed for his quick recovery. Nearly 11 hours later, at 11:13 am on Saturday, Congress leader Rahul Gandhi also posted on X expressing concern over his health and wished him a fast recovery, hoping he returns to public service with full strength. Meanwhile, UP Congress in-charge Avinash Pande said Ajay Rai’s condition is stable and he is likely to be discharged soon. Chest pain at party office, collapsed on way home In Lucknow, the Congress party held a teachers’ and doctors’ conference on Friday on Labour Day and Buddha Purnima, attended by several leaders including Avinash Pande and Supriya Shrinate. After the programme, Ajay Rai went to drop UP in-charge Avinash Pande at the airport and later returned to the party office at Mall Avenue, where another event was underway. It was here that he developed chest pain and told colleagues he was feeling uneasy and needed to go home. While being taken to his apartment in Telibagh, his condition worsened and he fainted in the car. He was immediately rushed to Medanta Hospital. Tests conducted to rule out heart attack Medanta Lucknow director Dr Rakesh Kapoor said Ajay Rai was admitted to the emergency ward with complaints of chest pain, uneasiness and fainting. He was treated under specialist supervision. Blood samples were sent for testing. Considering the possibility of a heart attack, Troponin-T and Troponin-I tests were conducted, which came out normal. A brain CT scan was also done to rule out stroke, and no serious issue was found. Doctors confirmed that there is currently no danger to his health. stories.title: ‘Two stools don’t make a chair’:Akhilesh Yadav shares video and takes dig at UP deputy CMs; Keshav hits back, says, 'Natural to be wary of duo pair'
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party (SP) chief Akhilesh Yadav on Friday night shared a controversial reel of UP Deputy Chief Ministers Keshav Prasad Maurya and Brajesh Pathak on ‘X’, drawing sharp reactions from them. The video with the background music, “Duniya ke thagon se bachne zara…,” captioned “Do stools ko milane se kursi nahi banti,” takes a dig at the leaders. Fourteen hours later, Maurya hits back at Akhilesh Yadav, claiming Akhilesh’s fear of the “fit and hit pair” is justified. Replying to his post on X, Maurya wrote the atrocities committed against the deprived and labour classes under Akhilesh’s rule have neither been forgotten nor will they be forgotten. The public will settle accounts by making the lotus bloom. Akhilesh's video shows both Deputy CMs together The video, shared by Akhilesh at 10 pm, captures both Deputy CMs when they visited Kushinagar on the occasion of Buddha Purnima on Friday. Both leaders are seen walking and smiling in a park in the video with the song, “Duniya ke thagon se bachne zara" playing in the background. Pathak is heard saying that they are at the Mahaparinirvana site of Lord Buddha in Kushinagar. In the video, Pathak highlights Buddha’s message of peace and compassion Buddha Purnima, coinciding the International Labour Day. The video also contains remarks encouraging youth and references to developmental projects carried out in the state under Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Keshav Maurya’s counter-attack on X On Saturday morning, Maurya wrote on X that he and Pathak are a “symbol of public trust”, and said that he's a descendant of Emperor Chandragupta Maurya and and draw inspiration from his ideals of building an undivided India. He also linked himself to Lord Gautam Buddha’s legacy of peace, equality and justice. Maurya said the people of Uttar Pradesh will never forget the injustices against backward and labour communities, such as Shakya, Kushwaha, Maurya, Saini and others, under Akhilesh Yadav’s reign. The answer to such injustices will be given democratically by making the “lotus bloom”. What expert says on their political rivalry Senior journalist and political expert Prem Kant Tripathi said Akhilesh’s “thagon” remark should be viewed in the context of his "Pichhda, Dalit and Adivasi (PDA)" politics. Tripathi said Maurya tried to connect himself with Maurya dynasty, yet, at the same time, BJP is responding to a backward leader through another backward leader, while CM Yogi himself avoids direct responses to Akhilesh's criticisms. Akhilesh-Maurya rivalry isn't new It is not the first time that both leaders traded barbs in public. Both leaders are rooted in OBC politics and have exchanged heated remarks in the Assembly before. They also disagree over who to credit for caste census. While Akhilesh claimed it was due to SP pressure, Maurya credited it to BJP. During the Maha Kumbh mela, Akhilesh raised questions on water quality of the “Sangam”, which Maurya called an insult to “Sanatan Dharma”. Akhilesh had earlier called Maurya a “Delhi’s pawn” and “Delhi Wi-Fi password,” and Maurya responded by calling SP as "Samaptwadi Party”. Attacks intensify post-Lok Sabha election After the Lok Sabha elections, Akhilesh intensified attacks on Keshav Maurya. Experts say SP’s PDA formula worked in the elections, with 37 MPs elected, out of which a large number belonged to backward communities. Since then, Akhilesh has repeatedly targeted Maurya, calling him a “Delhi pawn” and even offering slogans like “bring 100, form government,” while BJP has responded through counter-remarks.

stories.title: Kashi saints condemn Maulana Sajid Rashidi statement:Demand strict action over alleged provocative remarks; says statement dangerous for unity, peace
stories.summary: There is deep anger in the saint community of Kashi over a controversial statement made by Maulana Sajid Rashidi. The saints have described it as an attempt to disturb social harmony and have demanded strict action from the administration. The Sant Samiti general secretary Swami Jeetendranand Saraswati took a strong stand in the matter and issued a warning statement. He said that such provocative and violent statements not only increase tension in society but also pose a threat to the unity and peace of the country. Addressing Maulana Sajid Rashidi, Swami Jeetendranand Saraswati said that talking about violence against any religion or community is highly irresponsible. He also said that the Hindu community believes in law, the Constitution and the government, but this does not mean that anyone can continuously use provocative language without any response. What is the controversy? During an interview, Maulana Sajid Rashidi allegedly said that “if you do not recite the Kalma, you will be killed” and also stated that until fear is created in the Hindu community, they will not listen. After this statement came to light, the issue has been escalating. Reaction of the saint community The saints of Kashi have termed the statement highly objectionable and provocative. They said that such remarks spread enmity in society. The Sant Samiti has demanded that the administration investigate the matter and take appropriate legal action so that no one uses such language in the future.

stories.title: Kanpur doctors implant world's smallest pacemaker in 77-year-old man:Install ₹20 lakh wireless device without surgery for free
stories.summary: Doctors at the Heart Institute (Cardiology) have achieved a major breakthrough in medical treatment by giving a 77-year-old man a new lease of life with the world’s smallest wireless pacemaker — implanted without major surgery or any incision. What makes the case more remarkable is that the capsule-sized pacemaker, which costs around ₹15 lakh to ₹20 lakh in the market, was provided free of cost to the patient under a government health scheme. 77-year-old from Mainpuri suffered dizziness, heartbeat dropped to just 20 Hargovind, a 77-year-old resident of Mainpuri, had been frequently feeling weak and would suddenly collapse unconscious. When he was brought to the Heart Institute in Kanpur, tests revealed that he had a complete heart blockage. His heartbeat, which should normally be around 70, had dropped drastically to just 20 to 40 beats per minute. Blocked veins ruled out conventional pacemaker surgery Senior doctor Avadhesh Sharma said the patient’s condition was extremely serious. Normally, a pacemaker is implanted through surgery near the collar bone, but in Hargovind’s case, severe blockage in the veins made the traditional procedure impossible. Doctors then opted for the world’s most advanced capsule pacemaker. Why this tiny device is better than a regular pacemaker A conventional pacemaker is about the size of a matchbox and is implanted under the skin through surgery. It carries a risk of infection and its battery usually lasts only 10 to 12 years. In contrast, the capsule pacemaker has no wires, eliminating the risk of veins getting blocked in the future. Its battery life is also significantly longer — around 20 to 25 years — reducing the need for replacement. ₹20 lakh treatment provided free under Pandit Deendayal scheme The cost of the advanced treatment had initially worried the family, as the device is priced between ₹15 lakh and ₹20 lakh in the market. However, the institute carried out the entire treatment free of charge under the Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay Scheme. Following the successful procedure, Kanpur’s Heart Institute is now moving towards becoming a Centre of Excellence in advanced cardiac care. Capsule reached the heart through a vein in the leg Dr Umeshwar Pandey, Dr SK Sinha and their team carried out the complex procedure by inserting the tiny wireless capsule pacemaker through a vein in the patient’s leg (groin) and guiding it directly into the heart, where it was implanted. The entire process was completed without any incision or stitches.

stories.title: May begins in UP with cool winds, rain:Temperatures drop, heatwave relief likely for 10 days
stories.summary: The start of May in Uttar Pradesh has brought relief, with light rain and strong winds over the past three days leading to a drop in temperatures on Friday. Cool winds throughout the day provided respite from intense heat, and the weather remained pleasant. Maximum temperatures in several districts remained well below normal. Gorakhpur recorded a maximum of 26.4°C — the third lowest in observation history — while Ballia logged 27.5°C, the fifth lowest on record. In 15 districts, maximum temperatures ranged between 30°C and 32°C. In contrast, Orai was the hottest at 41.6°C, while Hardoi recorded a minimum temperature of 17°C. See weather pictures- Good rainfall in 24 hours; fresh rain expected from May 4 Several districts recorded substantial rainfall in the past 24 hours — Kannauj (54 mm), Balrampur (52.6 mm), Lakhimpur Kheri (51.8 mm), Bareilly (29 mm), and Gorakhpur (23.8 mm). The rain helped lower temperatures and provided relief from heat. According to Dr Atul Singh, senior scientist at the Regional Meteorological Centre in Lucknow, the weather is expected to remain dry for the next two days, with temperatures likely to rise by 6 to 8°C due to sunshine. A fresh western disturbance is expected to become active from May 4, which may trigger another spell of storms and rain. No heatwave expected in early May As per the monthly forecast, Uttar Pradesh is likely to receive above-normal rainfall in May 2026. However, heatwave days may be above normal in the Terai region, while eastern UP is expected to see normal conditions. Overall, maximum and minimum temperatures across most parts of the state are likely to remain normal or slightly above normal. The weather department has clarified that no heatwave conditions are expected during the first 10 days of May due to active weather systems. Rain damages crops; CM orders compensation survey Continuous rainfall has caused damage to crops, particularly vegetables. Farmers fear losses to cucumber, melon, and watermelon crops, with concerns of rotting due to excess moisture. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has directed officials to assess the damage on the ground and prepare reports swiftly so that compensation can be provided to affected farmers. How will the weather be for the next 5 days? Mixed conditions ahead: warm nights, localised heat Some areas may still experience heatwave conditions during afternoons, along with warmer nights. A fresh spell of rain and thunderstorms may bring a temperature drop of 2–4°C, improving heatwave conditions. Rain activity is expected to begin in western UP and gradually move eastward. El Niño concern for monsoon Between June and September, Uttar Pradesh and the rest of the country may receive below-normal rainfall. IMD Director General Dr M Mohapatra said conditions are shifting from La Niña to El Niño in the Pacific Ocean, which typically leads to reduced rainfall. Lower snow cover in the northern hemisphere between January and March may also impact the monsoon. Know about El-Nio and La-Nia-
